lines.speaker: ADITYA
lines.text: Alice, we have an important recruitment requirement.

lines.speaker: ADITYA
lines.text: Three positions. Six applications arrived today, and more will come.

lines.speaker: ADITYA
lines.text: I need you to select the right people. Every decision matters.

lines.speaker: ALICE
lines.text: Background checks usually take a few days. Is there a deadline?

lines.speaker: ADITYA
lines.text: Tonight is the deadline. Their documents, their histories, their faces. Check all of it.

lines.speaker: ADITYA
lines.text: Your job isn't just to hire people. Your job is to protect this company.

lines.speaker: ALICE
lines.text: Understood. I'll verify every candidate before making a decision.
